def transform(grid):
    # Repeat the input with a rotation that cycles across tiles; demonstrated
    # expansion pattern maps row/column indices by 180-degree rotation on outer bands.
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tr in range(3):
        for r in range(n):
            row = []
            for tc in range(3):
                flip_v = tr != 1
                flip_h = tc != 1
                for c in range(m):
                    rr = n - 1 - r if flip_v else r
                    cc = m - 1 - c if flip_h else c
                    row.append(grid[rr][cc])
            out.append(row)
    return out
PY
